intended_use.summary: Compare an optional provider-neutral Ollama adapter using the already-local Llama 3.2 3B Instruct Q4_K_M model against the retained deterministic Runbook Sentinel control on frozen synthetic SRE cases. The model receives evidence-only context, no credentials, tools, approvals, executor access, or real operational data.

sources.name: Meta Llama 3.2 3B Instruct Q4_K_M through Ollama

evidence.note: Official registry lists llama3.2:3b-instruct-q4_K_M at digest prefix a80c4f17acd5, 2.0 GB, 128K context, text input.
Local API reports family llama, 3.2B parameters, GGUF Q4_K_M, context length 131072, and completion/tool capabilities.

criteria.note: Local and official registry identities agree on the exact instruct quantization.

evidence.note: Meta's primary model card identifies Meta as developer and documents the Llama 3.2 3B family.
Ollama's primary registry identifies its packaged 3B instruction model and intended local use.

criteria.note: Meta is authoritative for the base model; Ollama is authoritative for this packaged quantization.

evidence.note: llama3.2:3b is already local at ID a80c4f17acd5 and size 2.0 GB; no download, account, secret, or fee is required.

criteria.note: Approved access is limited to the existing local artifact through loopback Ollama.

evidence.note: Llama 3.2 Community License grants limited royalty-free use, reproduction, modification, and derivative rights subject to license, attribution, and acceptable-use conditions.
The AUP prohibits operating critical infrastructure and other harmful uses. This gate approves only synthetic evaluation with no real infrastructure interaction.

criteria.note: Local synthetic research use is approved. Model weights may not be redistributed. Any model-containing product must carry the license, required notice, and Built with Llama display. Real-infrastructure operation is prohibited by both the AUP and project boundary.

evidence.note: Local Ollama manifest links the Meta license and use policy, template, parameters, and exact model blob; no custody transfer into the repository occurs.

criteria.note: The local manifest traces the packaged model through Ollama to Meta's Llama 3.2 materials.

evidence.note: Manifest SHA-256 a80c4f17acd55265feec403c7aef86be0c25983ab279d83f3bcd3abbcb5b8b72. Config, model, template, two license, and parameter blobs were each recomputed and matched their six declared SHA-256 digests; model blob dde5aa3fc5ffc17176b5e8bdc82f587b24b2678c6c66101bf7da77af9f7ccdff is 2019377376 bytes.

criteria.note: Every referenced local blob matches the content-addressed manifest.

evidence.note: Primary model card describes an instruction-tuned 3B text model, recommends application-specific adversarial evaluation and system safeguards, and warns that small models have distinct safety/helpfulness tradeoffs.
Registry describes instruction following, summarization, prompt rewriting, tool use, and agentic retrieval as candidate capabilities.

criteria.note: Fit is limited to candidate evaluation on frozen English synthetic cases. Accuracy, structured-output reliability, attack success, latency, and repeated reliability remain empirical gates, not assumed passes.

evidence.note: Meta states Llama models should be deployed as part of a guarded system and evaluated in application context.

Runbook Sentinel treats model output as untrusted, supplies synthetic evidence only, exposes no tools or secrets, and keeps deterministic policy, approval, execution, replay, and postcondition controls outside the model.

criteria.note: The model is isolated to local synthetic generation; no personal data, secrets, network tools, approval material, or real operations are in scope.
